excluded_from: every published conclusion; verify.py filters these by the canon field in rounds.jsonl, not by directory name
why_this_file_exists: quotes.jsonl.gz rows carry no canon field, so a reader opening the quote file directly has only the directory name to go on. A directory name is a second transcription of the same fact and does not survive being copied under a different name (it did not, 2026-09-25). This file travels with the contents.

real_fix: quote rows should carry the same `canon` field that round records already carry, so the content states its own status. The round preimage is nine named fields, so an extra key does not change roundKeccak; it applies to new data only, because published files are append-only (A8). This marker is the stopgap for data already published.
